h1: The “Basic” design package — complete interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: The “Basic” design package — complete interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: “Basic” is a complete interior design project for an apartment, house, or commercial space: a layout, photorealistic 3D visualization, and the essential working drawings for the construction crew.

Choose it before a renovation or a layout change, when you need to decide in advance where the partitions, plumbing, electrical wiring, and lighting will go and which finishing materials will be used. You see the interior before work begins and receive the drawings it will be built from.
We record the dimensions of the rooms and the location of walls, openings, windows, doors, and utilities. The entire project is built on this plan.
A functional layout with furniture, plumbing fixtures, and key interior elements. We take into account room dimensions, circulation, ergonomics, storage systems, and how you use the space.
Where needed, we show which structures to demolish and where to build new partitions — so the crew knows exactly what to change on site.

The locations of plumbing fixtures and the required utility connection points are determined. Bathrooms, guest toilets, kitchens, laundry rooms, and other spaces that require plumbing connections are worked out in detail.
If the project includes underfloor heating (electric or another type), we mark out its zones around the furniture and plumbing fixtures.

A plan is developed showing the location of outlets, electrical connection points, and appliance connections. The electrical layout is designed around the future arrangement of furniture, the kitchen, TVs, workspaces, and other equipment.
The location of switches and the main lighting control scenarios: the lighting is convenient to use, and the necessary electrical connection points are planned in advance.

A plan is developed showing the placement of general and decorative light sources. Depending on the interior concept, the project may include ceiling fixtures, track systems, pendant lights, wall sconces, LED strip lighting, and other solutions.
A plan of the ceiling structures is developed, taking into account lighting, built-in elements, and the architecture of the space.

The types and boundaries of floor coverings, laying directions, and transitions between materials are defined. This makes it possible to agree in advance on the use of parquet, engineered wood flooring, ceramic tile, porcelain tile, and other floor coverings.

blocks.text: 11. Wall elevations for the kitchen and bathrooms

parts.html: For the kitchen and bathrooms, which have many built-in elements and utilities, we prepare wall elevations: they show exactly where the furniture, plumbing fixtures, tile, outlets, and appliances will go.
A list of the main finishing materials in the concept — so that you and the crew know what’s needed to bring the interior to life.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations of each main room: even before the renovation, you can see how the materials, furniture, lighting, color, and decor work together.
This way, the interior is agreed on before it starts being built on site. The price includes one full round of revisions to the concept.
One of the main advantages of “Basic” is the set of working drawings: once the layout and concept are approved, the designer prepares it for the construction crew.
The builders get clear instructions on partitions, plumbing, electrical work, lighting, ceilings, and floors, and fewer decisions have to be made on the fly during the renovation.

The package can be used for apartments in new developments, apartments in existing buildings, private houses, condos, investment properties, offices, beauty salons, stores, showrooms, and small commercial spaces.

If a renovation lies ahead and the interior is being created from scratch: you need to plan the layout and furniture arrangement, design the electrical, lighting, and plumbing systems, choose the finishes, and hand working drawings over to the crew.
A package for those who want to see the interior in 3D visualizations and receive a complete design project but don’t need extended support.

A complete design project: a layout with furniture arrangement, a style concept, 3D visualizations, electrical, lighting, plumbing, ceiling, and floor plans, wall elevations, and a set of working drawings for the renovation.
€35–45/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000.
The final cost depends on the floor area of the property, the number of rooms, the complexity of the layout, and the scope of technical documentation required.

You can add design supervision, a detailed renovation cost estimate, furnishing and procurement (furniture, lighting, decor), and the design and manufacture of custom furniture — kitchens, wardrobes, and other cabinet furniture — with delivery and installation, as well as a turnkey renovation. That way, you work with a single contractor from the design project to the finished interior.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN takes residential and commercial interiors from layout and concept through to working drawings, custom furniture, and implementation.
We work primarily in Bratislava and Vienna and also take on projects in other European cities and in the USA.
